posts.text:
Rafael Câmara is set to replace Ocon at Haas alongside Bearman in 2027, RacingNews365 reports. The deal was agreed in Singapore, with a formal announcement expected this week.

https://racingnews365.com/haas-finalise-new-f1-driver-line-up-with-esteban-ocon-replacement-chosen

Tom Hart will be Verstappen's race engineer in Austin, Brazil and Las Vegas. Lambiase will still attend as Head of Racing, with no date announced for the permanent handover.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=verstappen-hart-race-engineer-austin

McLaren plans upgrades in stages to fight for podiums and test aerodynamic concepts for 2027. Stella says the final three races should give a clearer view of whether wins are possible.

https://www.motorsport.com/f1/news/mclaren-to-phase-upgrades-for-2026-fight-and-next-years-f1-development/10864787/
